_: The notes 'What's new' shows after an update, and the update bar in the Windows and phone apps. Newest first; edit when releasing. Build time comes from the commit.
notes: A top bar as in Acrobat: Menu, Home and Create, with help, what is new and the other Add Dots apps; in the Windows app it is the title bar too
Every mark can be selected, moved and resized after placing: highlights, underlines, pen, stamps and notes
Open, Save and Print buttons next to Home; Save goes straight to the folder you pick
Merge PDFs joins the files you pick into one document
Find shows the match you are on clearly, with next and previous buttons
